external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: A supplier that uploads compliance paperwork and signs in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: A category manager who reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The SaaS vendor that hosts the portal, issues supplier credentials, and pushes supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.
processes.notes: The vendor's datasheet says the platform is secure by design, that it uses enterprise-grade encryption throughout, that all access is fully authenticated and audited, and that the product is fully compliant.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: A service that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes the records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor-hosted platform where supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organisation's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: The database into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A supplier signs in to the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: A supplier uploads compliance paperwork to the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: A category manager reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decisions

data_flows.name: store paperwork
data_flows.description: The supplier document portal stores uploaded compliance documents on the vendor platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_flows.name: retrieve paperwork
data_flows.description: The supplier document portal retrieves uploaded paperwork from the vendor platform for review.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded
data_flows.notes: The retrieval is implied by the portal providing uploaded documents for review.

data_flows.name: issue credentials
data_flows.description: The vendor issues a username and password to a supplier.

data_flows.name: push data extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description says: "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." The runbook says: "the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These are incompatible claims, so encryption in transit is unknown.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the nightly file from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes the extracted supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier documents and staff contact details are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The vendor platform holds insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier data extract in the landing bucket is confidential.
assumptions.basis: The landing bucket holds a supplier data extract, which contains supplier records derived from the stated compliance paperwork and staff contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier records in the supplier database are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The supplier database holds records loaded from the supplier data extract, which contains the stated supplier information.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The system is explicitly described as a portal through which suppliers upload documents and category managers review them.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor hosting environment is a tenant boundary.
assumptions.basis: The text states that the vendor hosts the SaaS product and the organisation does not run any part of it.

assumptions.assumption: The organisation's cloud account is a network boundary.
assumptions.basis: The bucket, service, and database are stated to share the organisation's cloud account, distinguishing their cloud network location from the corporate network and vendor hosting.
